cases.prompt: Amdahl: serial fraction 0.1, 8 processors. Give speedup as number.
Gustafson: measured serial fraction 0.1 at 8 processors. Give scaled speedup.
Binary balanced sum reduction of 8 inputs, one level per synchronous round. Number of rounds?
Binary sum reduction of 8 inputs, count only binary additions. Total additions?
Inclusive prefix sum of [3,-1,4,0]. Return the full array.
On EREW PRAM two processors read the same memory cell in the same round. Is this allowed? Boolean.
CRCW processors concurrently write different values to one cell, but no conflict policy is specified. Is the final value uniquely determined? Boolean.
CUDA: __syncthreads() is reached only by threadIdx.x < 16 in a block of 32 active threads. Is this a safe block-wide synchronization? Boolean.
Scan n>=1 integers for the maximum on unit-cost RAM. Return worst-case time and extra space using {time:"linear"|"constant",space:"linear"|"constant"}.
A synchronous parallel scan step reads an immutable snapshot of the previous step. May it instead use unordered in-place writes while claiming the identical synchronous semantics? Boolean.
